description: Quarterly FDIC financials (Call Reports) for every FDIC-insured US bank, 1984 on: one row per bank (the insured bank, not its holding company) per quarter-end. Amounts in $ THOUSANDS; ratios in percent (FDIC's, annualized). Income items are YEAR-TO-DATE (Q3 = nine months); roe_quarterly is one quarter. since/until: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on report_date. Defaults: report_date desc, 50 rows. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_bank_financials

cert.description: FDIC certificate #, the stable bank key.

name.description: Name part, any case; 1-3 chars = whole word.

name: get_bank_financials
